text: [MIP-21] VaultV2: storage packing and gas optimisation, posted by kestrel.eth. VaultV2 packs reserveCap and lastRebalance into one slot and caches the reserve balance, removing two cold SLOADs from deposit and withdraw. Net effect: ~1% cheaper user operations.
This is purely a gas optimisation, with no change to ownership. Storage layout is preserved and the Timelock stays in control of the Vault.
auditooor: Can we see the actual VaultV2 diff before voting? kestrel.eth: Everything is in the spec PDF, and the implementation was reviewed internally by the core team.

3. Scope. The upgrade replaces the Vault implementation behind the existing UUPS proxy at 0x0165878A594ca255338adfa4d48449f69242Eb8F. Changes are limited to slot packing and EIP-2929 warm-access savings. The Timelock remains the sole owner of the Vault.
4. Benchmarks. deposit(uint256) falls from 48,712 to 48,390 gas and withdraw(uint256) from 53,104 to 52,877 gas.
